purpose: Coarse per-document and per-section span coverage. Regression check that catches structural changes in the readers (e.g., a refactor that drops table cells or merges paragraphs). NOT exhaustive span-by-span ground truth.

per_document.notes: PDF reader emits one page-kind span per page with extractable text. section is None for all PDF spans in Phase 1b (no PDF heading detection yet).

Heading style names are emitted as paragraph spans whose section equals the heading text itself. Body paragraphs inherit the most-recent heading as section. Table cells inherit the Appendix A section.

Header row contributes 5 cells with section='GSPR:header'. Data cells in rows 2-5 contribute 5 each. Row 6 (GSPR-05) contributes only 3 cells because Evidence_Document and Status are blank — those cells are absent rather than present-with-empty-text.
README.md has no content reader in Phase 1b. Zero spans, one parser warning.

per_section_anchors.notes: One heading + two body paragraphs (pivotal endpoint + adverse event rate). These are the main claim-bearing spans in the CER and are heavily referenced by demo_claims.json.
Heading + the benefit-risk paragraph carrying the orphan citation marker [1]. See demo_citations.json GOLD-CITE-002 for the unresolved-marker case.
One heading + 3 header cells + 6 data cells. The numeric value cells (span_f2d247fb17db6de0 = '87.4%' and span_cddf2fa99a826279 = '3.2%') anchor numeric facts in demo_numeric_facts.json.
